audit.whatIsWrong: Morgana is misgendered as 'he/his' across tldr, three dosFull/dontsFull titles, and three report entries.
audit.why: Morgana is on the female enemy list; the owner is addressed as 'you', so third-person pronouns describing the enemy must be she/her.
audit.corrected: See per-field edits — every 'he/his' referring to Morgana changed to 'she/her'.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Dark Binding as matchup-defining but never gives its cooldown (lint: COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Dark Binding (Q) is a flat 10s cooldown at every rank — stating it tells the reader exactly how often the root recurs.
audit.corrected: Morgana's Dark Binding (Q) is a flat 10s cooldown — the three-second root, minion-blockable, pool follows wherever it lands. Keep Magical Journey (E) banked for her best play. Your ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.

audit.why: suspectNames flagged 'late' -> 'Her Black Shield' as fuzzy, but Black Shield is Morgana's real E name per the kit — false positive, no change.
phases[].side and content.win[] already agree on every row (Skill x7) and match the packet levelChart. No chart edit needed.
